description: Register a GcsObjectResource (upload/download/list/delete/exists for objects within a bucket) for use by other components -- fills the gap left by gcs_resource (raw client only) and gcs_bucket_resource (bucket lifecycle only).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

credentials_env_var.label: Credentials Env Var
credentials_env_var.description: Env var holding a path to a GCP service account JSON key file. Unset uses application-default credentials (same convention as gcs_bucket_resource's credentials_env_var).

name: GCS Object Resource
